messages:
Maya Patel: morning — kicking off a short day‑0 sync for Merchant PPO's proof-of-value. I want to confirm agenda, success criteria, and immediate blockers.
Ethan Liu: sounds good. suggest we cover: 1) stakeholders + access 2) eval prompts + datasets 3) infra/pricing expectations 4) security/gov Qs + timelines.
Sofia Ramos: +1. can we also surface any required SSO/SCIM work up front? legal wants to know auth model.
Maya Patel: yes — ask for SSO and SOC2/RFC docs early. merchant wants to run enterprise dataset queries, so we need clear data handling.
Ben Carter: pricing question from buyer: are we flexible for a 3‑week pilot vs monthly committed? they asked about a short-term, limited token cap.
Ethan Liu: we can do a short pilot on hosted with a token cap and feature flags enabled. will need to log that as a temporary discount in the PO. ops: @Ben, do you want me to draft terms?
Ben Carter: please, a short addendum with limits (tokens, models allowed, request concurrency) would be perfect.
Sofia Ramos: security-bot, we need the questionnaire status for Merchant PPO.
security-bot: automatic: merchant-ppo-sq-2026.pdf uploaded to https://redwood.internal/sec/merchant-ppo. questionnaire fields outstanding: data-retention, encryption-key-ownership, access-review.
Maya Patel: thanks. Sofia — can you take the data-retention / key ownership asks? I can coord with buyer's security engineer.
Sofia Ramos: on it. also want to confirm success criteria — proposed: 1) 95th perc latency < 200ms for short prompts, 2) F1 > 0.78 on labeled eval set, 3) end-to-end integration with their API and SSO in staging. anyone object?
Ethan Liu: that's reasonable. add: stable throughput of 50req/s sustained during peak eval window.
Ben Carter: buyer also wants an example prompt set and eval harness. do we have a sample they can run locally?
Maya Patel: yes — link to our PoV eval template: https://redwood.ai/templates/pov-eval. will also share a minimal cURL example for smoke tests: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"rw-m-1", "input":"Extract invoice numbers from: \"Inv 12345\""}'
```
Ethan Liu: nice. for staging access we need their IPs if they want IP allowlist. ask them to send the CIDR block.
Sofia Ramos: security question: do they require bring-your-own-key (BYOK)? if so, will need HSM/KMS handoff steps and timeline.
Maya Patel: good point. buyer said they prefer KMS but didn't confirm HSM. I'll ask and capture in the intake.
Ben Carter: timeline check — customer wants a 3‑week evaluation window starting next Monday. are we staffed to support that (oncall + SE coverage)?
Ethan Liu: yes, we can do SE coverage M–F. oncall overlap OK; runtime team can support a canary pool if load spikes.
security-bot: reminder: ping for SOC2 doc acceptance may take up to 5 business days from legal.
Maya Patel: noted. I'll set expectations with buyer.
Maya Patel: immediate action items: 1) Ben — draft short PO addendum for token cap & discount 2) Sofia — confirm SSO/KMS requirements with their security engineer 3) Ethan — provision staging creds + ask for CIDR 4) Maya — schedule weekly check-ins and share eval prompt template.
Ben Carter: will have a draft addendum by EOD tomorrow.
Sofia Ramos: I'll reach out to their security lead and update the questionnaire by tomorrow afternoon.
Ethan Liu: provisioning started — staging API key will be shared to merchant-ppo@secure-mail by 2481234600. need CIDR from them to finish.
Maya Patel: perfect. I'll send a summary + calendar invite for a 30m kickoff with stakeholders: buyer PM, buyer security, our SE, eng lead, and finance. proposed time: Monday 10am PT.
Maya Patel: one more ask — can everyone drop two short examples of the prompt types they expect (classification, extraction, freeform) into this thread before EOD? that'll help us pre-populate the eval harness. :thumbsup:
Ethan Liu: done — I'll add a couple.
Sofia Ramos: will add security-related prompts.
Ben Carter: adding pricing examples.
Maya Patel: thanks team. syncing again after the kickoff.
note: This thread is a condensed day-0 planning sync. No title per agents.md rules.
